productName: Who Is Watching — Real-Time Tracker, Ad-Tech Vendor & Identity ID Inspector

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of auditing third-party trackers and identity vendors on websites getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With Who Is Watching, Named Vendor & Category Attribution runs right where you already work. Exposes Concrete Tracking Cookies & Pixel IDs and One-Click Forensic HTML & Markdown Audit Report—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle auditing third-party trackers and identity vendors on websites, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch Who Is Watching in action: Translates obscure tracking domains into plain-English company names across Ad-Tech, Session Recording, Fingerprinting, and Analytics categories. See the actual persistent identifier keys and pixel IDs set in your browser during the session—not just a vague counter. Plus, export a timestamped compliance and security report of every tracker detected on a page for GDPR, FERPA, or vendor procurement audits. Unlike commercial tracker extensions owned by ad conglomerates, Who Is Watching runs 100% on your device with zero outbound network calls. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
